meta.description: Motherhood & lifestyle content for women building a beautiful family life without the perfection pressure. Faith, wellness, real moments, and everyday joy.

hero.headline: Mess, motherhood, and the grace of Christ
hero.lead: I'm Cheyla!  A mom of three just trying to show up with honesty, a little faith, and absolutely zero perfection. This is a space for the moms who love their babies and still have hard days. Who believe in God and still fall apart sometimes. If you're looking for a highlight reel, this isn't it. But if you need someone to sit with you in the real, then you're in the right place.
